reasoning_content:
No node or python are available on the host. That's not a problem — the guide says Node.js isn't needed on the server side (everything runs inside a container).

Let me try parsing the hex ports with shell arithmetic:

action.command: for f in /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6; do awk -v f=$f 'NR>1 && $4=="0A" {print f, $2}' $f; done | while read f addr; do port=${addr##*:}; echo "$f $addr port=$((16#$port))"; done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "for f in /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6; do awk -v f=$f 'NR>1 && $4==\"0A\" {print f, $2}' $f; done | while read f addr; do port=${addr##*:}; echo \"$f $addr port=$((16#$port))\"; done", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "List listening ports with shell hex parse"}
